ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central high-intensity white patches on both lobes, flanked by a thick low-intensity black perimeter. Extensive black punctate mottling and irregular speckling are distributed within the interior white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serration along the trailing edge with medium-frequency peaks; amplitude increases significantly at the distal tips due to biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-aligned low-intensity linear marks; notably a thick diagonal stroke on the left lobe and a set of intersecting thinner rake-like marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation (barnacle clusters) visible on the terminal ends of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, isolated circular dark spots (focal points) scattered within the high-intensity white regions of both lobes.
